gaps.lead: 'I will definitely complete the report by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen a better film this year.
gaps.sentence: This is ___ I've seen this year.
gaps.explanation: I haven't seen a better film = this is the best film (that) I've seen.

gaps.lead: Someone must check this equipment before every flight.
gaps.explanation: must check → must be checked (modal + be + past participle).

gaps.lead: A committee is looking into the sudden rise in food allergies.
gaps.sentence: The sudden rise in food allergies ___ a committee.
gaps.hint: phrasal verb in the progressive passive
gaps.explanation: 'A committee is looking into X' becomes the passive 'X is being looked into by a committee'.

gaps.lead: The doctor persuaded me to promise that I would exercise daily.
gaps.sentence: The doctor ___ that I would exercise daily.
gaps.explanation: get somebody TO do something = persuade/make them.

gaps.lead: The guidebook says this bridge is Roman.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally said or believed to be.
